meta.title: Mataresit — Receipts, read and ready
meta.description: Mataresit turns photographed, emailed and bulk-uploaded receipts into clean, categorized line items your team can approve in minutes.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Guides, setup walkthroughs and workflow recipes.

apiReference.title: API reference
apiReference.description: Endpoints and webhooks for pulling receipts into your stack.

help.title: Help centre
help.description: Answers from the support team, usually within a day.

status.title: System status
status.description: Uptime history and live incident tracking.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Product notes, Malaysian tax tips and release news.

card.description: Every line item now carries its tax code into the exports your accountant already uses.

hero.eyebrow: AI receipt processing for small teams
hero.lede: Photograph it, email it, or drop a whole month of scans at once. Mataresit reads the line items, tax and merchant, then routes only the uncertain fields to your team.

how.title: Three steps, no spreadsheet.
how.lede: The work you used to do after hours — typing totals, guessing categories, hunting for a missing receipt — happens while the coffee is still warm.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Forward an email, photograph the paper copy, or upload a month of scans in one drop.

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Merchant, date, line items and sales tax are read and matched against your categories.

review.title: Review
review.description: Only the uncertain fields ask for a human. Approve once and the month's totals move.

features.title: Built around the receipt, not the form.
features.lede: Everything below is part of the same workspace: read a receipt, correct a field, approve it, and watch the books follow.

accuracy.title: Field-level accuracy
accuracy.description: Every extracted value carries a confidence score, so a shaky total is routed to review instead of quietly guessed.

typing.title: Save the typing
typing.description: Upload a batch and let the queue do the work. No totals to copy, no dates to reformat.

search.title: Smart search
search.description: Find any receipt by merchant, category, payment method or amount in a single field.

tax.title: Sales tax captured
tax.description: Tax is recorded per receipt and rolled into a running total, so the deduction never lives in a footnote.

team.title: Team collaboration
team.description: A shared inbox with a visible approval trail — who checked it, when, and what changed.

security.title: Workspace security
security.description: Receipts stay scoped to your workspace, with role-based access for the people who file and approve.

inside.title: A workspace that reads like a ledger.
inside.lede: The workspace is live, not a screenshot. Upload a receipt, watch the fields land, correct a category, and see the month's totals respond.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Spend, captured tax and review load, all derived from the same receipts you see below.

inbox.title: Receipts inbox
inbox.description: Search, filter and open any receipt down to its line items and payment method.

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Low-confidence fields wait here with their match score, not buried in a spreadsheet tab.

approval.title: One-click approval
approval.description: Approve a receipt and its status, totals and category chart update in place.

footer.blurb: Receipts in, books clean. Built for teams that would rather close the month than chase the paperwork.
